answer: To stop Sybil attacks, we use Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, agents must forge a digital identity by locking $5,000 in collateral. Second, peer validators check every task through a TEE. Third, successful uptime grows a reputation vine around the agent. Fourth, any double-signing leads to instant slashing. An attacker trying to spawn 100 fake nodes would face a $500,000 loss in bonds and 45 days of verification. This mechanism ensures that malicious actors cannot bloom like a lotus in a swamp of lies; they are instead pruned by the very cost of their own existence.
